name: SPSETIA
recent: S P Setia 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收和净利同比、环比均下滑。同期，公司宣布拟将 275.40 英亩土地出售给 Mah Sing 旗下子公司的交易，条件满足期限延长一个月。此外，总裁兼 CEO 在公开市场增持公司股份，而 EPF 则减持。
notable: 拟以非关联交易方式向 Mah Sing Group 旗下两家全资子公司出售约 275.40 英亩永久地契土地，条件满足期限延长至 2026 年 12 月 2 日。
总裁兼 CEO Datuk Zaini Bin Yusoff 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日和 16 日分别增持 30 万股和 20 万股普通股。
公司表示正按计划提交 REIT 上市计划。
risks: 第三季度净利同比下滑 52.1%，环比下滑 66.7%，净利率从上一季度的 11.9% 降至 4.8%。
拟议土地出售的条件满足期限已延长，交易尚未完成。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 MYR 672.551 million，同比下降 22.9%，环比下降 18.1%；净利为 MYR 32.614 million，同比下降 52.1%，环比下降 66.7%；净利率为 4.8%，低于上一季度的 11.9%。

recent_en: S P Setia reported weaker 3Q FY2026 results with revenue and net profit declining both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter. Meanwhile, the conditional period for the proposed disposal of 275.40 acres of land to Mah Sing subsidiaries was extended by one month. The President and CEO acquired shares in the open market while EPF reduced its stake.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of approximately 275.40 acres of freehold land to two wholly-owned subsidiaries of Mah Sing Group in a non-related party transaction; the conditional period was extended to 2 December 2026.
President and CEO Datuk Zaini Bin Yusoff acquired 300,000 and 200,000 ordinary shares on 13 and 16 November 2026 respectively.
The company said it is on track to submit its REIT listing plan.
risks_en: EPF sold nearly 4 million S P Setia shares over two days.
3Q net profit fell 52.1% year-on-year and 66.7% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin dropping to 4.8% from 11.9% in the previous quarter.
The conditional period for the proposed land disposal has been extended and the transaction is not yet completed.
earnings_en: 3Q FY2026 revenue was MYR 672.551 million, down 22.9% year-on-year and 18.1% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 32.614 million, down 52.1% year-on-year and 66.7% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 4.8%, lower than 11.9% in the previous quarter.
